aggregates.note: The printed terminal label on the slide's own scale bar. It is a property of the drawing's scale, 1 ballot = 0.22 design px, and not a count of anything in the world. The bar is six 500 ballot segments, so its end reads 3,000.

aggregates.text: The tolerance was 33 ballots wide. The gap was zero.
aggregates.note: The width of the ordinance's 1 percent tolerance expressed in ballots of the audited sample, 1 percent of 3,338 (C35 with C03) which is 33.38 and prints as 33. The slide sets the arithmetic out in full inside DETAIL A, and the frame re-derives it at render time in window.__akAssert with actual computed from the drawing's own SAMPLE constant rather than typed, so the number is proven by the picture that carries it. It is declared here rather than as a count because no claim states 33 and the gate's count kind wants one member per unit.

aggregates.text: DETAIL A . 12 TO 1 1 PERCENT OF 3,338 = 33 BALLOTS
aggregates.note: Not a span. This is the magnifier's own optical ratio, DETAIL A at 12 to 1, running straight into the next line's 1 PERCENT when the render flattens the block to one string. The 12 is a property of the artwork, the enlargement that makes a 5.6 px tolerance readable at 67 px.
